*Ledger*: Maintains orders dict {order_id → {reserved, captured, refunded, event_ids: set}}. apply(event) validates required fields (nonempty string id/order_id/kind, positive int amount), enforces invariants (reserve only on new order, capture ≤ reserved, refund ≤ captured), then mutates. **Critical Invariants**: (1) Event-id deduplication prevents duplicate outbox notifications. (2) Version + worker ownership prevents concurrent completion.
